taskjuggler_data_path.description: Override the path to the TaskJuggler data folder containing css, icons and scripts.

output_dir.description: Directory the reports should go into.

max_cores.description: Maximum number of CPU cores to use.

silent.description: Don't show program and progress information.

no_color.description: Don't use ANSI control sequences to color the terminal output.

debug_modules.description: Restrict debug output to a list of modules.

warn_ts_deltas.description: Turn on warnings for requested changes in time sheets.

add_trace.description: Append a current data set to all trace reports.

freezedate.description: Use a different date than the current moment as cut-off date for the booking file.

freezebytask.description: Group the bookings in the booking file generated during a freeze by task instead of by resource.
